_comment: Synthetic Mango calls for validating per-location Open Dental routing on STAGING.
POST to /api/mango/dev/seed (ALLOW_MANGO_DEV_SEED=true; prod never sets it).
No real caller data: every caller_number is either a designated OD test fixture
or an unassigned test range. called_number is the OFFICE DID — the attribution key.
Nothing here writes to Open Dental; seeding only sets review-then-send status.
479-739-4999 is the point of the exercise: it is on ONE patient in Riley
(PatNum 7115, Stedi TestValley) and TWO in Roland. Same number, different
practice, different outcome — which is only possible if office routing is real.

calls._case: VALLEY confident. One Riley patient on this number -> matched, PatNum 7115. Send this one to chart and check it chairside in Riley.
calls.summary: Staff took a call about scheduling a cleaning. [SYNTHETIC valley confident-match -> Riley PatNum 7115]
calls.transcript: Staff: Front desk, how can I help? Caller: Hi, this is Stedi TestValley, I would like to get a cleaning scheduled.

calls._case: VALLEY needs_review. Number not in Riley OD -> no confident match, so this is the Pick Patient path. Search TestValley; the modal must say it is searching Valley Fort Smith.
calls.summary: Caller asked about an appointment but did not give a name the matcher could use. [SYNTHETIC valley needs_review -> resolve via Pick Patient]
calls.transcript: Staff: Front desk. Caller: Hi, I wanted to ask about getting in this week.

calls._case: ROLAND control, SAME number as the valley confident call. Two Roland patients hold it -> needs_review with candidates. Proves the two offices are searching different databases.
calls.summary: Staff took a billing question. [SYNTHETIC roland control -> ambiguous, unchanged behaviour]
calls.transcript: Staff: Roland Family Dental. Caller: Hi, I have a question about my statement.

calls._case: UNKNOWN office. DID is not in MANGO_LINE_OFFICE -> office_not_connected. Every OD action must be blocked, in the UI and server-side; the not-a-patient close-out must still work.
calls.summary: Call on a line that is not mapped to an office yet. [SYNTHETIC unknown-office -> OD actions must be locked out]
calls.transcript: Staff: Hello. Caller: Hi, is this the dental office?
